|game_text='''0 side — Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi'''

Deploy Vader's Castle, [Set 13] Visage Of The Emperor, and a [Cloud City] site with exactly one [Dark Side]. For remainder of game, you may not deploy characters except bounty hunters, droids, and Imperials. Where you have an Inquisitor, your total battle destiny is +1 (+2 if with a 'Hatred' card). Inquisitors are destiny +1. While this side up, once per turn, may ▼ a [Cloud City] or Malachor battleground site. Flip this card if Vader is at a battleground site unless Luke, a Jedi, or a Padawan at a battleground site.

'''7 side — Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)'''

While this side up, you lose no Force from Visage Of The Emperor. While Vader armed with a lightsaber, opponent's Force drain bonuses are canceled. Flip this card if Vader not on table or if Luke, a Jedi, or a Padawan at a battleground site; once per game, may take Vader and your cards on him into hand from a site you control.

|rulings=* (7-side) The card '[[Darth Vader With Lightsaber]]' meets the condition to cancel opponent's Force drain bonuses.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Hunt%20Down%20And%20Destroy%20The%20Jedi%20/%20Their%20Fire%20Has%20Gone%20Out%20Of%20The%20Universe%20%28V%29 Scomp: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* The 7-side only cancels Force drain bonuses that come from LS cards affecting LS Force drains.
* For example, if LS Force drains at the DS system [[Eriadu]], the +1 bonus in [[Eriadu]]'s game text is not canceled because it is a DS card.
* For example, if DS Force drains at the LS site [[Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut]], the +1 bonus in the site's game text is not canceled because it is a DS Force drain.
